Current (231027) Status at all levels


Data submission


Facility level

• Inactive : Buyer not selected

• Not started : Buyer selected, no data submitted

• A : Buyer selected, some data submitted

• G : Buyer selected, all required data submitted.

See Suppliers overview page


Org level

• Inactive : None of the facilities have buyer selected : (All facilities = Inactive)

• Not started : 1+ facility have buyer selected, no data submitted by those facilities : (1+ facility not started, none A or G)

• A : 1+ facility have buyer selected, some/all data submitted by some facilities : (1+ facility A or G, but not all are G)

• G : 1+ facility have buyer selected, all data submitted by all facilities : (All facilities are G)



Action plan


Facility level

• Inactive : Buyer not selected

• Not started : Buyer selected, no actions in progress or completed

• A : Buyer selected, have 1+ action in progress or completed in year, but no savings & target date

• G : Buyer selected, have 1+ action in progress or completed in year, with savings & target date

See Suppliers overview page


Org level

• Inactive : None of the facilities have buyer selected : (All facilities = Inactive)

• Not started : 1+ facility have buyer selected, non of those facilities have actions in progress or completed

   (1+ facility not started, none A or G)

• A : 1+ facility have buyer selected, and at least 1 facility have 1+ in progress or completed action but no savings & target

   (1+ facility A or G, but not all are G)

• G : 1+ facility have buyer selected, and ALL facilities have 1+ in progress or completed action with savings & target

   (All facilities are G)
